notes.title: By popular demand – CUM is here! 💦
notes.content:
[h3]Your request, our action 😉

People have been asking us to add visualized orgasms for quite some time, and we're now delivering them, and delivering generously - bucket after the bucket! As we've said before, we're working on some mind-blowing animations that will change the way you look at such games - after all, art is art. If you're interested in checking out a few screenshots and a little glimpse into upcoming animations - jump into our Discord and check it out! 

Also, we'll post a devlog soon - free demo is getting closer, and it will be released in the middle of October, so wishlist the game and stick to our news.

Thank you for playing the previous chapters and for your feedback guys![/h3]
